pages.text: Open your inventory to see your backpack above the nine hotbar slots. Matching items share a grid entry with their total quantity. The grid is a list of items you can search and scroll through.$(br2)The hotbar, armor, offhand, equipped Curios, and crafting grid have their own space.

pages.title: Find Items
pages.text: Start typing when the inventory opens, or click $(thing)Search$() to focus it. Search by item name or registry ID, such as $(item)minecraft:oak_log$(). Use $(thing)@ModName$() to narrow results by mod, for example $(thing)@Biomes Black$(). Scroll or drag the scrollbar to reach more entries. At smaller GUI scales, more rows can fit on screen.

pages.title: Take and Deposit
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Left-click$() an entry to take up to one stack.$(li)$(thing)Right-click$() an entry to take half of that amount, rounded up.$(p)While holding a stack on the cursor, left-click the grid to deposit as much as fits. Right-click to deposit one item.
